description:
Don't want to deal with all the traffic, crowds, and hype surrounding the 4th of July, but still want to celebrate and enjoy the patriotic holiday? Step aboard the Adirondack III for a cruise to Winthrop to watch the fireworks and then sail back to Boston at the end. Enjoy a complimentary drink of any kind with your purchase! 

This 3-hour cruise/sail/fireworks event offers guests the opportunity to soak up Winthrop's fireworks display from an elegant and relaxing vantage point out on the water. The Adirondack III is a brilliant 80-foot long pilot schooner modeled after similar boats built in the 1890s. Ample space is provided on deck to accommodate each and every one of its guests, ensuring a comfortable and quality experience for anyone who boards.

In addition to a fantastic experience, this captivating Winthrop Fireworks Cruise will feature delicious, complimentary desserts.
##Notable Sites:
- The great views of the Winthrop Fireworks show and Boston's City Lights
- Within minutes of leaving the dock, you'll forget the distractions of life on land as you experience the joy of a leisurely night. In addition, you will get views of Boston’s Skyline and the fireworks display that cannot be matched anywhere else!

**Come join us as we celebrate our Independence!**

*******************
*Please note that we may not be able to raise sail for the fireworks due to crowding in the harbor. If time permits, we may do some sailing after the fireworks.*

*Please note that the fireworks are weather permitting*
*******************

##About Adirondack III
Inspired by the pilot schooners of the 1890’s, Classic Harbor Line’s Adirondack III is 80-ft in length, features teak decks, mahogany-trimmings, complete with 2 bathrooms, and just under 2,000 square feet of canvas to escort you through Boston’s historic harbor!
Though it is a light and lively sailing vessel, it is also quite comfortable, with ample deck space and seating for up to 41. It was designed and built by Scarano Boat Building of Albany, NY for taking groups of people on spectacular sightseeing adventures.
Sailing in this schooner is a delight. She moves through the water efficiently and beautifully; we take great pride in sharing her with you.
The Adirondack III is operated by Coast Guard-certified captains and an extremely friendly and talented crew. Our crew is known for their amazing hospitality, and are professionally trained and experienced in sailing our vessels well and safely. Do not hesitate to ask our crew about the boat or any of the Boston sites.
